description: Read curated, source-linked operating KPI observations for one exact Bullrun ticker. Coverage is sparse and no automatic KPI feed is configured: do not assume ARR, retention, customer counts or payments metrics are available. Check get_company_data_coverage first. Returns stored fiscal periods, units and source links; company-economics observations are a separate dataset. Read-only.

category.description: Optional category filter such as SaaS, payments, marketplace, banking, or other domain labels.

metricKey.description: Optional metric key present in stored coverage. No particular business KPI is guaranteed to be available.

ticker.description: Bullrun ticker, e.g. "CRWD", "SNOW", "V". Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure.

name: get_operating_kpis
title: Get operating KPIs
